visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to reduce banding.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly on Totem overlays and Mobile bottom sheets.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Colored shadows for primary actions (e.g., blue button casts blue shadow).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px borders with 10% opacity for structure. Active elements get 100% opacity border.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react date-fns react-qr-code`
Configure Tailwind: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the provided color palette and font families.
Font Setup: Add the Google Fonts link to `public/index.html` head.
Theme: Force 'dark' class on the `<html>` or `<body>` tag. Do not implement light mode toggle for this MVP phase (per user request: 'Dark theme mandatory').
RTL Support: Use `dir='rtl'` on the body when an RTL language is selected. Ensure layouts use logical properties (start/end) instead of left/right where possible.
Totem Mode: This page must be immersive. Hide standard navigation. Use Fullscreen API if possible.
Charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn/Charts) for the HR Dashboard analytics (Attendance Heatmap, Hours Worked).
Authentication: Implement a clean Split Layout for login (Image Left, Form Right).
PWA: Add manifest.json and service worker registration for 'Add to Home Screen' capability.
Language Selector: Needs to be prominent (Top Bar).
Testing: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered layouts everywhere.
Depth: Use z-index and subtle shadows to create depth in the dark interface.
Interaction: Every button press must have a scale-down effect (`active:scale-95`).
Spacing: Use `p-6` or `p-8` for container padding. Don't crowd the UI.
Accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratios are met (especially grey text on black backgrounds).
